say:2:1430306301:1.text: Referring to the high priestess without her title is disrespectful. Please remember to always call her by her full station, High Priestess Velara.
say:2:1430306301:1.source_cn: 直呼祭司的名字未免无礼，我更希望你能称她为冕下。
say:2:1430306301:1.male: Referring to the high priestess without her title is disrespectful. Please remember to always call her by her full station, High Priestess Velara.
say:2:1430306301:1.female: Referring to the high priestess without her title is disrespectful. Please remember to always call her by her full station, High Priestess Velara.

say:3:1430306302:1.text: These commoners forgot Her Majesty's grace and committed such sins against Sal'thorin.
say:3:1430306302:1.source_cn: 这些平民忘记了女王的恩赐，犯下了这样的罪孽。

say:4:1430306303:1.text: And sins can only be washed away by blood. We wholeheartedly support High Priestess Velara and her actions!
say:4:1430306303:1.source_cn: 这样的罪孽……只有鲜血来清洗，我们赞成奎茵冕下，无比支持她！
